svg.title: Which Extension Fits?
svg.desc: A decision chain for four support needs that ends in a built-in tool, a custom tool, a Skill or an MCP server depending on whether the need is generic, app-specific, a procedure or a shared live system.
svg.text: Oakhurst Support: match the need to the lightest extension that covers it.
